position_in_era.primary_genre_lineage: Argentine tango / bolero × hip-hop / soul / flamenco (Latin-American extension)
position_in_era.historical_role: Extends the translation lineage *outside* the Iberian peninsula — Argentine-born, Spain-based, fuses tango, salsa, hip-hop, soul, and flamenco. *Calambre* won the Latin Grammy for Best Alternative Music Album (2021). Methodological descendant of the same translation aesthetic at the Latin American end.

narrative_slots.production_facts: Released 2 October 2020 on Sony Music. Won Best Alternative Music Album at the 2021 Latin Grammys.
narrative_slots.member_dynamics: Born 1990 in Luján, Argentina; moved to Spain (Murcia, then Barcelona, then Madrid) as a child. The Argentine-Spanish dual rootedness is the engine of her translation work.
narrative_slots.cultural_venue: Iberian–Latin American axis; Madrid contemporary urban scene.
narrative_slots.instrumentation_details: Voice across tango, salsa, soul, hip-hop, flamenco-tinted production.
narrative_slots.release_circumstances: Latin Grammy 2021; sustained festival presence across Spain and Latin America.
